Name: Modern farm computer - CP
Author: LadyZomkie
Description:
Keeps the basic function, just replaces the sprite. I didn't like the old one so I made this for myself and then I thought maybe others wouldn't want to keep the original either because it doesn't match decor, really.

❤ 4 wood colors to match the vanilla game wood; birch, mahogany, walnut, oak (default: walnut)
❤ 3 different versions; left, right, front (default: front)


[size=3]✿✿✿✿ [size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size] ✿✿✿✿
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿ if you don't already have it[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ if you don't already have it[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and unzip this file, put it into your mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]Start the game and it will generate a config file where you can choose your computer[/size]
[/list]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (not a requirement), you can change them there (you have to click the menu and scroll to see all of them).
